_about: CTX-1 §2: when a message asks for a specific (palace context --layered, block [SPECIFICS]). Read on every turn, so edits apply without a rebuild. Matching is on lowercase words (letters, digits, apostrophes; a curly apostrophe counts as a straight one). 'phrases' match anywhere; inside a phrase '…' stands for one to six words. 'question_words' count only as the first word of a sentence or in a message holding a '?'. 'check_phrases' count only when the message also names a date or a number (a digit, a month or a weekday). The specifics are then shown only when the message also names an entity that has a live specific.
